BHA Edges Out Hull City in Thrilling Battle

BHA controlled the game by maintaining good possession at 50.4% and keeping the press intensity (PPDA, how hard a team pressed) low at 6.4. Hull City struggled with the press, operating at a higher PPDA of 12.5. Both teams followed the game plan well, with first contact winning set pieces recorded at 50%.

The match was defined by a few crucial moments. Hull City scored first via a counter-attack in the 41st minute when #9 Eli Oduya scored. However, the moment that truly decided the match came in the 63rd minute. BHA secured a goal from a set piece, with #5 Isaac Kane-Moss scoring a header assisted by #7 Tomas Calloway, which proved the margin of victory.
